description: The quotas of the TokenHound HUD (Claude, Codex, Copilot and more): a status bar item, a Dock panel and an optional sidebar section. It reads the hud.json file of TokenHound.

settings.label: Status bar value
settings.hint: What the status bar item shows for each provider.

settings.label: Hidden providers
settings.hint: Provider ids to leave out of every view, separated by commas, for example: gemini, claude-pessoal. The eye button of a provider in the sidebar section or in the panel adds it here; a click on a hidden chip in the panel, or on "N hidden" in the section, takes it out.

settings.label: Minimize the sidebar section
settings.hint: The sidebar section shows only its head and one line with the badge and the session percent of each provider. The arrow button in the head of the section does the same.

settings.label: Shortcut of the TokenHound panel
settings.hint: Saved in keys.json. Opens the panel as a dialog.
